Abdullah bin Khalaf bin Hattab Al Kaabi, Undersecretary of the Ministry of Interior, met with H.E Major General Staff Khalifa bin Harib Al Khubaili, Undersecretary of the Ministry of Interior of United Arab Emirates. During the meeting, the two sides discussed ways to enhance security cooperation and coordination between them.

Following the meeting, the two sides signed a Memorandum of Understanding on the Protection of Data and Information Exchanged in Joint Security Projects between the Government of the State of Qatar and the Government of the United Arab Emirates. The agreement aims to strengthen cooperation between the two countries and achieve a balance between their respective security and regulatory requirements.

Their Excellencies, the Undersecretaries of the Ministries of Interior of the two sisterly countries, also inaugurated the Bilateral Traffic Systems Integration Project and the Electronic Data and Deportee Fingerprint Exchange System Project, in the presence of a number of senior officers and officials from both sides.

These initiatives reflect the level of partnership and security integration between the two sisterly countries and contribute to enhancing the efficiency of joint security work and the development of data and information exchange systems, serving their shared security interests. #MOIQatar

MOI Organizes Specialized Workshop on Crises and Disasters

نظمت وزارة الداخلية ممثلة بالإدارة العامة للعمليات المركزية الاتحادية، ورشة عمل متخصصة في مجال الطوارئ والأزمات والكوارث، وبمشاركة الإدارات والقيادات العامة للشرطة على مستوى الدولة، حيث تناولت الورشة مواضيع في سياسات التعامل مع حالات الطوارئ والأزمات والكوارث، واستخدام الأنظمة الذكية في تعزيز العمل الشرطي بالتنسيق مع الشركاء الإستراتيجيين، إلى جانب عرض التجارب الخاصة في الدراسات الأمنية.

كما ناقشت الورشة عدداً من الحالات والفعاليات الأمنية وإجراءات استمرارية الأعمال لضمان تقديم الخدمات للمجتمع، بما يعزز من كفاءة الاستجابة ورفع الاستعداد والجاهزية في إدارة الأحداث.

Represented by the Federal Central Operations Department, the Ministry of Interior organized a specialized workshop on emergencies, crises, and disasters, with participation from police departments and general HQs across the country. The workshop addressed policies for managing emergencies, crises, and disasters; the use of smart systems to enhance police operations in coordination with strategic partners; and the sharing of best practices in security studies. 

Discussions also covered security scenarios, emergency response procedures, and business continuity measures to ensure uninterrupted service delivery, all aimed at stepping up response efficiency and raising preparedness levels in incident management.
